      <h1>Dingjin Chu<span class="hp-cn">初鼎晋</span></h1>
      <p class="hp-lead">I study how forests store carbon, how they respond to climate extremes, and how much they cool our cities — combining field inventories, multi-scale LiDAR and satellite records with interpretable models.</p>
      <p class="hp-role">Ph.D. Student · Land Surface Ecology &amp; Geospatial Science · Advisor: Dr. Lu Zhai</p>

<!-- ── About ────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<section class="hp-sec">
  <div class="hp-wrap hp-split hp-reveal">
    <div class="hp-side">
      <h2 class="hp-h2">About</h2>
      <a class="hp-more" href="cv.html">More about me →</a>
    </div>
    <div class="hp-prose">
      <p>My research asks questions such as: <em>Can a global biomass map be trusted to report the carbon in a local forest? Which forests hold their biomass through drought? Why do some urban forests cool their surroundings far more than others?</em></p>
      <p>To answer them, I combine field inventories (FIA, NEON) with airborne, spaceborne and terrestrial LiDAR and multi-decadal satellite records — see <a href="datasets_intro.html">Datasets</a> — and analyze them with statistical models, interpretable machine learning and process-based models — see <a href="methods_intro.html">Methods</a>.</p>
      <p class="hp-motto">Explore important <a href="projects_intro.html">research</a> questions using robust <a href="datasets_intro.html">datasets</a> and rigorous <a href="methods_intro.html">methods</a> under well-defined <a href="methods_assumptions.html">assumptions</a>.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── Representative work ──────────────────────────────── -->
<section class="hp-sec">
  <div class="hp-wrap">
    <div class="hp-head-row hp-reveal">
      <h2 class="hp-h2">Representative work</h2>
      <a class="hp-more" href="publications.html">All publications →</a>
    </div>
    <div class="hp-feat hp-reveal">
      <div class="hp-feat-fig"><img src="photo/research/climate_extremes_merged_ecosystem.png" alt="Climate extremes and ecosystem productivity"></div>
      <div>
        <span class="hp-venue">Environmental Research Letters</span><span class="hp-badges"><span class="hp-badge">2026</span><span class="hp-badge">Article</span></span>
        <h3>Future climate extremes enhance interannual variability of net primary production in Central Asia</h3>
        <div class="hp-authors"><strong>Chu, D.</strong>, Zhang, L., Wu, H., He, H., &amp; Ren, X.</div>
        <p>Using CMIP6 projections, intensifying droughts, heatwaves and wet extremes are shown to amplify year-to-year swings in plant productivity across Central Asia's drylands, making carbon uptake less predictable under warming.</p>
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/ae6dd4" target="_blank">Read paper</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hp-feat hp-reveal">
      <div class="hp-feat-fig"><img src="photo/research/AGB_estimation.png" alt="Forest above-ground biomass"></div>
      <div>
        <span class="hp-venue">SSRN</span><span class="hp-badges"><span class="hp-badge">2026</span><span class="hp-badge">Preprint</span></span>
        <h3>Local-scale bias in global products of forest aboveground biomass related to structural diversity, stand density, and forest age</h3>
        <div class="hp-authors"><strong>Chu, D.</strong>, Yang, H., Costanza, J. K., Yang, J., Murray, B., Mosely, J., &amp; Zhai, L.</div>
        <p>ESA CCI and GEDI L4B biomass are checked against national forest inventory data on U.S. Tribal lands. Both overestimate, the bias tracks stand structure and age, and correction models cut the prediction error by more than half.</p>
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7287457" target="_blank">Read preprint</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
function submitContactHome(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  var name        = document.getElementById('h-name').value;
  var email       = document.getElementById('h-email').value;
  var affiliation = document.getElementById('h-affiliation').value;
  var position    = document.getElementById('h-position').value;
  var message     = document.getElementById('h-message').value;
  var subject     = encodeURIComponent('Message from ' + name);
  var body        = encodeURIComponent(
    'Name: ' + name + '\r\n' +
    'Email: ' + email + '\r\n' +
    'Affiliation: ' + affiliation + '\r\n' +
    'Position: ' + position + '\r\n\r\n' +
    'Message:\r\n' + message
  );
  window.location.href = 'mailto:dingjinchu@gmail.com?subject=' + subject + '&body=' + body;
}

/* reveal sections as they scroll into view */
(function () {
  if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('hp-anim');
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (en) {
      if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add('hp-in'); io.unobserve(en.target); }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.hp-reveal').forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
})();
</script>
